properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured on 0.77.0): a tool's lessons reach an agent only through tools/list. On reflow2's own design that listing carries 218 lessons on 80 of 195 tools, and no reply reachable through `--call` carries one. Skill lessons do arrive, through get_skill. Among the lost ones is get_node's own lesson, which names the edge route the report says is missing (L19)
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, triage agent B. Item L6 of art:vscode-call-door-field-report-2026-10-02.

① OBSERVED (the report): "tools/list appends `steps` lessons to tool descriptions; a `--call` agent never reads tools/list. Skill lessons still arrive through get_skill."

② PRECEDENT: fact:field-report-vscode-copilot-with-mcp-blocked-reaches-reflow2-only-through-the-call-door-2026-10-01 already checked lessons.rs:230. req:the-cli-describes-any-tool-with-its-full-schema-and-lessons is the planned fix. This is ALREADY RECORDED as a limitation; what follows is the measurement and its cost.

⑤ MEASURED (main's export, 6,309 nodes, imported into a scratch store; logs in /home/ajs7/.claude/jobs/fa666a94/tmp/triage-B/):
- stdio tools/list from the same binary carries "LESSONS THIS DESIGN HOLDS" blocks on 80 of 195 tools, 218 lessons in all. Examples: loop_status 19, export_graph 11, record_finding 9, find_tools 7, add_decision 4, get_node 1.
- The find_tools reply carries 0. It ranks `self.tool_router.list_all()`, the raw list (query.rs:827), and returns a one-sentence summary.
- In code, lessons_for_step has exactly one caller, get_skill (skills_tools.rs:284), and enrich_tools has exactly one, tools_with_lessons (service.rs:7167), which only list_tools and the door's probe call.
- The door's probe is `ReflowService::in_memory()` (service.rs:6348, an EMPTY in-memory graph). So even the list the door builds holds zero lessons.

COST, ONE CONCRETE CASE: get_node's single lesson is fact:an-absence-claim-about-why-a-node-changed-read-only-the-node-and-missed-its-retiring-decision-2026-09-28. It says "read the node's connections (topic_report, or propagate_from depth 1)". That is the workaround for the report's L19 ("No edge reader"), and the door agent could not have met it.

⑥ CLASS: req:a-lesson-is-served-at-the-step-it-concerns delivers at two moments, the skill fetch and the tool listing. The door has the first and not the second. Any door that skips tools/list loses them silently, including a gateway or MCP client that truncates long descriptions. That is why dec:idea-the-cli-describes-a-tool-with-its-schema-and-lessons also floats a served describe_tool.

NOT AFFECTED: get_skill returns `lessons` beside the skill body, measured in this session.
